title: Microsoft Entra ID: extended 30-day backup and recovery through Microsoft 365 Backup
summary: The briefing passes: Microsoft's documentation supports Premium's opt-in default, licensing, price, recovery controls and retention. The billing path stops early in the setup wizard, and one broad statement about Microsoft 365 permissions should be narrowed.

claims.claim: The roadmap plans extended 30-day backup and recovery for a tenant's Entra objects.
claims.quote: Enable extended 30-day backup and recovery for a tenant's Entra objects via the Microsoft 365 Backup native app or M365 Backup Storage platform APIs.

claims.claim: The planned capability allows point-in-time restore to a last known good state within a rolling historical 30 days.
claims.quote: This capability allows customers and ISV apps to do a point in time restore of Entra objects to a last known good state to a rolling historical 30-day point.

claims.claim: Soft delete alone does not roll back erroneous changes to an object that still exists.
claims.quote: Instead of immediately and permanently removing an object, soft deletion places the object into a recoverable state for a limited retention period. During this time, the object can be restored with its properties and relationships intact.
